trailhead.label: Sella Sompdogna at the end of the road from Dogna, the board’s start

cautions: A short stretch of tarred road at the start.
Not advised in rain, snow or the hottest summer hours.
Ticks are common in the region: check your dog after the walk.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Sella Sompdogna at the end of the road f: Sella Sompdogna alla fine della strada da Dogna, partenza indicata dalla scheda ufficiale
textIt.A short stretch of tarred road at the st: Un breve tratto di strada asfaltata alla partenza.
textIt.Not advised in rain, snow or the hottest: Sconsigliato con pioggia, neve o nelle ore più calde d'estate.
textIt.Ticks are common in the region: check yo: Le zecche sono comuni nella zona: controlla il tuo cane dopo la passeggiata.
